v0.7.2부터 파일 목록에서 항목 위에 마우스를 올리면 <strong>: From v0.7.2, hovering over an item in the file list shows a short silent preview without opening the file. Choose Video preview under Settings → Appearance → File list hover preview. The default is Still thumbnail.
미리보기는 메인 재생이 정지되거나 일시정지된 동안에만 재생됩니다. 느린: Previews play only while main playback is stopped or paused. They can strain a slow HDD or NAS, so switch back to Still thumbnail if playback stutters.
메인 재생을 멈춘 상태에서 파일 위에 마우스를 올리면 소리 없는 짧은 미: With main playback stopped, hovering over a file plays a short silent preview.

v0.7.1부터는 <strong>같은 디스크 안에서</strong> 파일: From v0.7.1, video-specific settings are found again after you rename or move a file on the same disk and open it. The file must have been opened once in v0.7.1 or later before it was renamed. Copies on another disk and files whose contents changed are not matched automatically.
같은 디스크에서 이름을 바꾼 영상을 다시 열어도 영상별 모션 설정이 그대: A video renamed on the same disk keeps its video-specific motion settings when opened again.

If encryption is unavailable, new keys are kept only for the current app session. From v0.7.2 the app connects at startup without the Device screen being opened, and a device you disconnected manually is not reconnected.
